title: KBCard
description: Card-catalog front-matter for every KB document/passage. Agents search cards (cheap, few hundred tokens) before opening full documents (targeted) — the token-efficiency layer. The v1 taxonomy supplies the metadata vocabulary, demoted from gating ontology to retrieval metadata.

layer.description: fact_sheet = curated Tier-1 facts (governed); corpus = past responses & distilled Q&A (provenance-labeled, ungated); playbook = voice spec, lessons, kill-lists (flywheel-written).

summary.description: ≤10 lines. What's inside and when to open it. This is what agents read during card search.

type_tags.description: v1 atom-taxonomy types as metadata (e.g. ocm, methodology, product_expertise).

section_types.description: Which normalized section types this content typically serves (exec_summary, methodology, pricing_narrative…).

question_forms.description: P17/C2 (B65 enrichment step 1, B75§5): the questions this chunk answers, emitted by the ingest questioner seam. FINDABLE, NEVER QUOTABLE — the X10 generated_description posture: catalog metadata joined into _catalog_text for scoring, living in frontmatter only, so targeted_open's body return and every drafting prompt never contain them. Model-generated retrieval aids must not become groundable content; the named test is tests/kb/test_question_forms_findable_never_quotable.py.

outcome.description: Corpus layer: the result of the pursuit this content came from — provenance, not a ranking key. Near-duplicate ingestion keeps the won survivor (engine/kb/ingest.py) and curation notes a lost source; retrieval does NOT rank on it (deterministic tie-breaking only, ranker tuning deferred — B41(1)/B46; P26a P0-10 corrected the earlier 'prefers won' claim).

edit_survival.description: Observed survival rate when this content was used in drafts — flywheel-updated quality signal.

claim_tier_max.description: Highest claim tier contained — tells the drafter whether Claim Audit will scrutinize passages sourced from here.

use_restriction.description: D2: this client's work may not be reused as reference or exemplar. Honored at retrieval — the card is withheld and the exclusion recorded in kb_retrieval. Added by B12 — the flag was decided (D2) before any schema defined it.

legal_hold.description: D2: suspends purge and aging-out for this card; overrides retention automation. Added by B12.

canonical_block.description: This card's body is approved boilerplate the drafter reproduces near-verbatim with the card cited in kb_retrieval (consumer lands P7). v2-local concept, no spec source — see B12.

provenance.description: RESTRICTED field — never surfaced into drafts; used for audit and de-anonymization by authorized humans only.

derived_from.description: kb_ids this card was derived from (merge, distillation, exemplar extraction). D1: purge follows these links so removing a source client removes everything derived from its material. Added by B12 — D1 calls the derivation-surviving link build-time, not retrofit.

authored_by.description: P17/C2: who authored the SOURCE this card came from. The firm corpus only ever holds 'firm' (the ingest gate refuses the rest — S4/T3, untouched); the pursuit memory lane records all three because its material dies with the pursuit and never grounds Tier-1 claims (B75§2).

owner.description: Required for fact_sheet layer; optional elsewhere.

verified_date.description: fact_sheet layer: last verification. Stale facts flag in Claim Audit.

review_due.description: fact_sheet layer: when this fact must be re-verified (set by the steward, e.g. cert expiry or verified_date + policy interval). Feeds the fact_sheet_staleness metric. Added by B8 — the metric referenced this field before any schema defined it.

content_path.description: Where the full document lives (file path / object key).

grain.description: WP13 two-tier grain. corpus cards wrap a structure-aware chunk; fact_sheet cards are subpoint atoms (one claim, one owner, one verified date). Absent on cards written before WP13 — treat as 'chunk'.

canonical_doc_id.description: The persisted canonical document model (L1) this card derives from. Root of the purge-cascade and re-ingestion match chain.

doc_path.description: Heading path within the source document, outermost first (e.g. ['6.0 Accelerators and Tools','6.0.2 Data Migration']). NAVIGATION AND PROVENANCE ONLY — never a retrieval key, never the card's identity. A past response's outline is the structure one buyer demanded; treating it as canonical destroys subpoint re-cut.

chunk_span.description: Diagnostic, never enforced. Size is observed to catch extraction bugs — a forty-page chunk means sections were merged, not that content is too long. No token limit is applied anywhere in the pipeline.

elements.description: Count of canonical-model elements merged into this chunk.

content_origin.description: generated_description = a vision model's caption of a figure, not text that existed in the document. Same fabrication exposure as VLM table extraction: must never ground a Tier-1 claim — enforced structurally (such a card can never be layer fact_sheet, see allOf below, and fact_catalog filters it as a belt), not via claim_tier_max, which has no readers (X10 deviation, B59). (WP13 R13.)

figure_class.description: Picture-classification result. logo and signature are anonymization targets — confidential artifacts that text-based scanning cannot see — and are removed rather than described.

extraction_status.description: degraded = extraction was imperfect. The card is STILL ingested and STILL retrievable — ingestion is never gated on extraction quality (X6). manual = human-entered or hand-corrected.

identity.description: Content-anchored identity so card ids survive re-ingestion. Without this, a better OCR pass orphans every edit_survival score attached to the card — the flywheel's accumulated memory.

content_hash.description: Hash of normalized chunk content. Primary match key on re-ingestion.

structural_key.description: Heading path + element position. Tiebreak when content drifts slightly.

source_hash.description: Content hash of the L0 source artifact.

matched_from.description: On re-ingestion: the prior kb_id whose history this card inherited.

drift.description: Normalized content distance from the matched prior version. Reported in the reconciliation report; high drift is reviewed, not silently merged.

then.description: B8: the governed layer's owner/verified_date requirement was prose-only; now enforced.
WP13 R13 as structure: a generated description can never BE a fact card, so it can never enter the fact catalog the Claim Auditor grounds Tier-1 against (B59).
